# SciForge-Edu Question Authoring Specification v1

Status: Draft

Version: 1.0

Purpose:

Define a standard question format that can be:

* generated by AI
* reviewed by humans
* imported by SciForge-Edu
* rendered into exams

This specification is the canonical interchange format for SciForge-Edu.

---

# Design Principles

SciForge-Edu separates:

1. Repository
2. Composer
3. Workbench

All questions entering the system should first be converted into the SciForge Question Format.

---

# File Encoding

Required:

* UTF-8

Recommended:

* XeLaTeX compatible

---

# Supported Objects

Version 1 supports:

* Question
* Question Group
* Choices
* Solution
* Images

---

# Single Choice Question

Example:

```latex
\question

下列何者為鹽酸？

\begin{choices}

\choice NaOH

\CorrectChoice HCl

\choice NaCl

\choice H2O

\end{choices}

\begin{solution}

HCl 為鹽酸。

\end{solution}
```

Rules:

* Exactly one CorrectChoice
* At least two choices
* Solution required

---

# Multiple Choice Question

Reserved for future versions.

Not yet supported.

---

# Question Group

Example:

```latex
\begin{questiongroup}

閱讀下列文章後回答問題。

\question

第一題

\begin{choices}
...
\end{choices}

\begin{solution}
...
\end{solution}

\question

第二題

\begin{choices}
...
\end{choices}

\begin{solution}
...
\end{solution}

\end{questiongroup}
```

Rules:

* Group stem appears once
* Questions appear inside the group

---

# Images

Example:

```latex
\question

觀察下圖。

\includegraphics[width=0.5\textwidth]{images/acid_base.png}

下列敘述何者正確？

...
```

Rules:

* Relative paths only
* Image files must accompany the question source

---

# Solution

Example:

```latex
\begin{solution}

因為鹽酸的化學式為 HCl。

\end{solution}
```

Rules:

* Solution is mandatory
* Solution is not shown in student papers
* Solution may appear in teacher papers

---

# Unsupported Content

Do not generate:

```latex
\documentclass
\begin{document}
\end{document}
```

SciForge imports question content only.

Not full exam documents.

---

# AI Authoring Rules

When generating SciForge-Edu questions:

1. Output valid LaTeX.
2. Use exactly one CorrectChoice.
3. Always include a solution.
4. Do not embed answers in the stem.
5. Do not generate a complete exam document.
6. Generate only question content.

---

# Valid AI Prompt

Generate 10 junior-high-school science questions.

Output format must follow the SciForge-Edu Question Authoring Specification v1.

Requirements:

* Single-choice questions
* Four options per question
* Exactly one CorrectChoice
* Include solution for every question
* XeLaTeX compatible
* No documentclass
* No begin{document}
* Output only question content
